info.name: Get information for the security specified

items.docs: Information returned depends on the view specifed in the request.

params.name: secIds
params.description: Unique identifier of a security. Multiple entries must be pipe-separated '|'.

params.name: universeIds
params.description: Unique five-letter identifier created by combining a two-letter Investment Type code and three-letter country code.</br> Multiple entries must be pipe-separated '|'.

params.name: langCult
params.description: Language and locale, for example, en-US

params.name: dataPoints
params.description: Unique identifier of a data point. Can be data point ID or short ID.

items.docs: Create response data for the securities specified in the `secIds` parameter. You can specify up to 20 securities. The primary identifier used  in the call is the Morningstar security ID. Ticker identifers or CUSIP are also accepted.  The value(s) entered appear as the first data point in the output for each security. </br></br> Use the `dataPoints` parameter to specify the data returned in the response. You can enter  a data point ID or the corresponding short ID.  You can only specify data poin
